parts.text: A bar magnet is made of metal.

parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) Fig. 8.1 shows the bar magnet being inserted into a coil of wire. The N-pole and the S-pole of the bar magnet are marked. Fig. 8.1 The coil is connected to a galvanometer.
